recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light grey (#F2F2F2). 2. Place title text "Precision" at top center in large, bold, red (#C00000) sans-serif font. 3. Place slide number "9" inside a yellow (#FFC000) circle at the top right corner. 4. In the top-left region below the title, place a grey (#D9D9D9) fraction-style box: top line "Correctly Classified (as Positive)", bottom line "Total Classified as Positive (either Correct and Erroneous)", separated by a red (#C00000) horizontal line. 5. In the middle-left region below the fraction box, place a yellow (#FFF2CC) highlight box: header "Meaning" in bold red (#C00000); body text "% of what you Predicted as POSITIVE is Actually Positive" with "Predicted" in red (#C00000) and "POSITIVE" in blue (#0070C0). 6. In the middle-left region below the Meaning box, place a white (#FFFFFF) box with a red (#C00000) border containing the formula text "Precision = TP / TP + FP" in black (#000000). 7. In the middle-center region, place a white (#FFFFFF) box with a blue (#0070C0) border containing two lines: "Precision= 5/(5+0)" and "= 100%" in black (#000000). 8. In the middle-left region below the formula box, place two beige (#FFF2CC) speech bubbles side by side: left bubble text "Positive Classified as +ive", right bubble text "Negative Classified as +ive"; connect them with a green (#00B050) curly bracket; below the bracket place text "All Samples classified as Positive" with "classified" in red (#C00000) and the rest in black (#000000). 9. In the bottom-left region, place a light blue (#DEEBF7) bordered box: first line "Whatever objects you retrieved as positive, I can trust you" in black (#000000); second line "(Irrespective of how many MISSED Positive samples)" in red (#C00000) italics. 10. In the top-right region, place the first confusion matrix as a grid chart: header row "Predicted as" with columns "P" and "N"; header column "Actual" with rows "P" and "N"; cell (P,P) = "TP" with green (#70AD47) background; cell (P,N) = "FN"; cell (N,P) = "FP"; cell (N,N) = "TN" with green (#70AD47) background; all text black (#000000) on white (#FFFFFF). 11. In the top-right region directly below the first matrix, place the second confusion matrix as a grid chart: same headers "Predicted as", "P", "N", "Actual", "P", "N"; cell (P,P) = "5" inside a blue (#0070C0) circle; cell (P,N) = "25"; cell (N,P) = "0" inside an orange (#FFC000) circle; cell (N,N) = "70" with green (#70AD47) background; all text black (#000000) on white (#FFFFFF). 12. In the bottom-right region on the left side, place a tree diagram labeled "Positive" in red (#C00000): root node red (#C00000) circle containing "30"; left child red (#C00000) circle containing "5" with label "TP"; right child green (#70AD47) circle containing "25" with label "FN"; draw red (#C00000) arrows pointing outward from both leaf nodes; place a simple line-art airplane icon above the root node. 13. In the bottom-right region on the right side, place a tree diagram labeled "Negative" in green (#70AD47): root node green (#70AD47) circle containing "70"; left child green (#70AD47) circle containing "70" with label "TN"; right child red (#C00000) circle containing "0" with label "FP"; draw red (#C00000) arrows pointing outward from both leaf nodes; place a simple line-art airplane icon above the root node.
